description: This source file, UtilHttp.java, contains utility functions for handling HTTP requests and responses within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for managing request parameters, session data, attribute maps, content streaming, security headers, URL encoding, and more. It serves as a comprehensive helper class for HTTP-related operations in web applications.

classes.name: UtilHttp
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for HTTP request and response handling, including parameter parsing, session management, content streaming, URL encoding, security headers, and request metadata extraction within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getCombinedMap
methods.description: Creates a combined map from servlet context, session, attributes, and parameters of a HTTP request, with optional attribute skipping.

methods.name: getParameterMap
methods.description: Produces a canonicalized map of request parameters, merging query parameters, path info, and multipart data.

methods.name: getServletFileUpload
methods.description: Initializes and returns a file upload handler configured with request-specific size limits and temporary directory.

methods.name: getMultiPartParameterMap
methods.description: Extracts multipart form data, including file uploads, into a map with support for form fields and files, and handles encoding.

methods.name: getMaxUploadSize
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum upload size configured for HTTP file uploads, defaulting to -1 if not set properly.

methods.name: getSizeThreshold
methods.description: Obtains the size threshold for in-memory vs. disk storage during file uploads.

methods.name: getTmpUploadRepository
methods.description: Returns the temporary directory used for storing large file uploads during processing.

methods.name: getQueryStringOnlyParameterMap
methods.description: Parses and returns parameters explicitly present in the query string part of the URL.

methods.name: getPathInfoOnlyParameterMap
methods.description: Extracts parameters passed in the URL path segments following a specific '/~KEY=VALUE/' syntax.

methods.name: getUrlOnlyParameterMap
methods.description: Combines query string and path info parameters into a single map.

methods.name: canonicalizeParameterMap
methods.description: Normalizes parameter values, decoding URLs, handling URLs inside strings, and trimming spaces.

methods.name: canonicalizeParameter
methods.description: Performs strict URL canonicalization, encoding, and decoding to create a normalized string.

methods.name: getJSONAttributeMap
methods.description: Creates a simplified JSON-compatible map representation of request attributes.

methods.name: parseJSONAttributeMap
methods.description: Processes a map to prepare it for JSON serialization, converting certain types to strings.

methods.name: parseJSONAttributeValue
methods.description: Recursively processes attribute values for JSON serialization, handling timestamps, maps, and lists.

methods.name: getAttributeMap
methods.description: Returns all request attributes as a map, optionally skipping specified attribute names.

methods.name: getSessionMap
methods.description: Returns all session attributes as a map, optionally skipping specified attribute names.

methods.name: getServletContextMap
methods.description: Returns all application context attributes as a map, optionally skipping specified attribute names.

methods.name: makeParamMapWithPrefix
methods.description: Creates a parameter map by filtering request parameters with a specific prefix and suffix.

methods.name: makeParamListWithSuffix
methods.description: Constructs a list of parameter values matching specific prefix and suffix patterns from request and extra fields.

methods.name: getApplicationName
methods.description: Determines the application name from the request context path, replacing slashes with underscores.

methods.name: setInitialRequestInfo
methods.description: Stores request-specific info into session attributes, including URL, locale, and headers.

methods.name: getServerRootUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the server root URL based on request scheme, server, and port.

methods.name: getFullRequestUrl
methods.description: Builds the complete request URL including path and query string.

methods.name: getRequestMethod
methods.description: Determines the HTTP request method, considering overrides via the '_method' parameter.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the effective Locale for the request, considering session, user login, and application defaults.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the user's locale in the session.

methods.name: setLocaleIfNone
methods.description: Sets the user's locale if not already set in the session.

methods.name: setTimeZone
methods.description: Assigns a TimeZone object to the user session.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Retrieves the current TimeZone from session or user login info, defaults to system default.

methods.name: setTimeZoneIfNone
methods.description: Sets the TimeZone in session if not already set.

methods.name: getVisualTheme
methods.description: Returns the current VisualTheme stored in session.

methods.name: setVisualTheme
methods.description: Associates a VisualTheme with the user session.

methods.name: getCurrencyUom
methods.description: Determines the ISO currency code for the user, considering session and user login, defaults if necessary.

methods.name: setCurrencyUom
methods.description: Sets the session attribute for currency ISO code.

methods.name: setCurrencyUomIfNone
methods.description: Sets the currency code in session if not already specified.

methods.name: urlEncodeArgs
methods.description: Converts a map of arguments into a URL-encoded query string.

methods.name: getEncodedParameter
methods.description: URL encodes a single parameter string.

methods.name: getRequestUriFromTarget
methods.description: Parses and extracts the URI part from a request target string.

methods.name: getQueryStringFromTarget
methods.description: Extracts the query string component from a request target string.

methods.name: removeQueryStringFromTarget
methods.description: Removes the query string component from a request target.

methods.name: getWebappMountPointFromTarget
methods.description: Identifies the web application mount point from a request target URL.

methods.name: encodeAmpersands
methods.description: Converts '&' characters to '&' in HTML strings where not already entities.

methods.name: encodeBlanks
methods.description: Replaces spaces with '%20' in strings for URL encoding.

methods.name: setResponseBrowserProxyNoCache
methods.description: Sets HTTP headers on response to disable browser caching.

methods.name: setResponseBrowserDefaultSecurityHeaders
methods.description: Sets security-related HTTP headers to enhance response security, including X-Frame-Options, security policies, and HSTS.

methods.name: getContentTypeByFileName
methods.description: Determines MIME content type based on filename extension.

methods.name: streamContentToBrowser
methods.description: Streams a byte array to the browser with specified content type and filename, setting response headers appropriately.

methods.name: streamContentToBrowser
methods.description: Overloaded method to stream byte array content without filename.

methods.name: streamContentToBrowser
methods.description: Streams input stream content to the browser with detail about content length and filename.

methods.name: streamContent
methods.description: Copies data from InputStream to OutputStream efficiently, with buffering, and handles resource closing.

methods.name: stripViewParamsFromQueryString
methods.description: Removes specific view-related parameters from a query string, optionally based on paginator number.

methods.name: stripNamedParamsFromQueryString
methods.description: Removes specified parameter names from a query string.
